## Quanta Services Jumps 9.3% as AI-Driven Power Project Backlog Surges

PWR's backlog surge is real-world, contracted evidence that AI power demand is translating into project flow — a second-order confirmation of the hyperscaler capex buildout theme and a concrete read on power and grid infrastructure as a binding constraint on AI deployment timelines.

- PWR stock gained 9.3% per the headline following a reported surge in project backlog.
- Backlog growth is explicitly attributed to AI-driven power projects, linking hyperscaler demand directly to power infrastructure contracting.
- Coverage asks whether the bull case has changed, implying market is reassessing the magnitude of the opportunity.
- High classifier confidence; move characterized as both a datacenter buildout signal and a deployment constraint read.
